task: Fix Focused view pinned-chat sorting to use pin-order (like Unified view) instead of last-activity recency.

key_reasoning.reason: Two components across two layers (focusedChatSidebarViewModel.ts sort logic; ChatSidebarLists.tsx container wiring of pinOrderStore into the Focused builder), but the pattern is exactly precedented by the sibling Unified-view implementation (sortPinnedByPinOrder).

Exact pattern already exists and is fully unit-tested in the Unified view (pinOrderStore + sortPinnedByPinOrder); this is a copy-and-adapt into the Focused builder. Slight risk from changing a positionally-parameterized function signature and two existing tests that currently assert the buggy date-based order, which keeps this from scoring pure XS.
